_doc: TANG 1 — CONG SOAT SAU NHAP (chep Sales Desk ai_fallback.js enforceReplyEvidence + ai_fallback_gate.js enforcePolicyClaims + payment_claim_kit.js, 25/09/2026). Phan CHUNG moi nganh: danh tinh bot, cau 'da nhan tien' (bot KHONG BAO GIO tu xac nhan — anh Dung chot 24/09), xin SDT khi chot (he thong gui phieu), coc / so tien khong nguon, hua doi tra khong chinh sach, 'da doi xong', xin them anh → link, link trang khac, ETA khong nguon, trang thai don khong tra cuu, tu cho tra sau, noi link quen. Regex chay tren CAU DA BO DAU (tru truong ghi 'cut'/'codeInLink'/'carrierCode'/'codePattern' chay tren cau goc). Cho trong: {khach}/{Khach} (xung ho), {shop}, {site}, {tenShop}, {tenNguoiPhuTrach}, va cho rieng tung luat ({ten} {ma} {size} {ton} {gia} {link} {danhSach} {cm} {doiDangDi}). KHONG ten rieng shop, KHONG con so rieng shop (validator chan). Nganh ghi de tung khoa trong nganh/<id>/cong-soat.json (danh sach noi them, chu ghi de).

Chu 'anh' go KHONG DAU la dai tu (doi thanh `replacement` truoc khi doc mau xin anh), TRU KHI: chu theo sau chac chan ve anh (photoAfter, moi kieu go); hoac tin go hoan toan khong dau va dung sau dong tu xin/xem/them/chup/co (askBefore) voi chu theo sau hop (askAfter), hay sau 'gui' (sendBefore) voi chu theo sau la mau/sp (sendAfter). Dai tu dung ngay truoc chu 'ảnh/hình' co dau (photoNext, chay tren cau goc) thi bo han ('Gửi anh ảnh với' = xin anh). Go dung 'ảnh' co dau khong bao gio bi dong toi. orderedItem._doc: 05/10/2026 (phieu Desk 'khach da co don bot ban lai', ca ma + size da dat): LUOI CUOI — cau tra loi (moi tang) bao HET dung MA + size cua mon trong DON DANG CHAY gan chac voi hoi thoai (het vi chinh don cua khach da giu) → thay menh de bang `replacement`, bo menh de/cau goi y mau thay the ngay sau. Chi khop theo MA (hoac cau tro 'mau nay' khi mau dang noi toi chinh la ma trong don), KHONG theo ten (nhieu ma khac mau trung ten). Menh de nhac ma khac / size khac thi giu nguyen. Khach da noi ro MUA THEM (dong tu mua + them, sau luc tao don) thi giu nguyen (bao het la dung). Nganh noi them cau tro rieng (vd 'doi nay') trong nganh/<id>/cong-soat.json.

THA: cau hoi ('co dung mau ... khong a?'), cau ro dat ('chua chac dung mau'), ma khach TU GO hoac ma IN TREN ANH (doc duoc chu), cau nguoi truc da noi. Nganh noi them tu cua nganh (vd 'doi') trong nganh/<id>/cong-soat.json.

priceStory._doc: 05/10/2026 (phieu Desk 'bot bia ly do doi gia va cai gia khach'): he thong KHONG luu lich su gia (khong co gia cu, ngay doi gia), nen MOI cau giai thich VI SAO gia doi ('vua cap nhat gia', 'gia dot truoc', 'web chua kip cap nhat', 'het chuong trinh giam gia', 'do ti gia') la BIA → cat cau, them `reply`, goi nguoi (`storyReason`). Mau nao nguoi truc / chinh sach / ho so shop cung noi thi mau do co nguon, khong cat. Khach DANG DOI CHIEU gia (`contest`, tren tin khach) va neu MOT SO TIEN ('1250', '1250k', '1.250.000', '1tr25') ma cau bot noi SO KHAC → bo cau co so khac, them `reply`, goi nguoi (`contestReason`) — chay SAU luat chung cu / tien (cau co gia sai so voi du lieu da duoc doi ve gia du lieu). So tran (khong don vi) cua khach chi tinh la nghin dong khi ngay truoc no la tu chi gia (`bareLead`). So dinh chu ('IE0841') la ma, khong phai tien. Tat ca tren chu da bo dau.

bargain._doc: 05/10/2026 (phieu Desk 'khach mac ca kieu viet tat'): KHACH XIN BOT GIA — ke ca cau rat ngan chi co SO TIEN + 'duoc khong' ('1tr dc kh a', '1tr2 duoc ko': so tien doc bang CUNG bo doc tien cua cong, `amountAsk` la phan dung NGAY SAU so tien) hoac cum xin bot (`ask`). Hoi CHUONG TRINH sale ('giam bao nhieu %', 'dang sale khong', 'co giam gia khong') KHONG phai mac ca (`notBargain`, xet truoc). Sua nhap theo LUA CHON MAC CA cua shop (ho so `banHang.macCa`, tang 3): cau HOI NGUOC khach muon gia bao nhieu (`askTarget`) luon bo; cau HUA BOT / nhan so tien khach dua (`promise`) bo tru khi shop chon 'giam toi da'; shop 'khong giam' / 'qua tang' → cau gia niem yet (`reply`, mau dang sale thi `replySale`) dat len dau neu nhap chua noi (`refusal`); shop CHUA KHAI → khong hua, cau `replyUnset`, goi nguoi (`unsetReason`). Tat ca tren chu da bo dau; khong con so cua shop nao.
